tasks.label: Session 2: PX4 SITL
args: echo [WAIT] MicroXRCEAgent on UDP 8888... && until ss -uln | grep 8888; do sleep 1; done && echo [OK] Agent detected. Starting PX4 SITL... && cd ~/PX4-Autopilot && make px4_sitl gz_x500_mono_cam_rrc

tasks.label: Session 3: QGroundControl
args: echo [WAIT] PX4 SITL ROS2 bridge... && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && until ros2 topic list | grep /fmu/out/sensor_combined; do sleep 1; done && echo [OK] PX4 detected. Launching QGroundControl... && QGroundControl

tasks.label: Session 4: Sensor Combined Listener
args: echo [WAIT] sensor_combined topic... && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && until ros2 topic list | grep /fmu/out/sensor_combined; do sleep 1; done && echo [OK] Topic available. Launching listener... && cd ~/ws_sensor_combined && source install/local_setup.bash && ros2 launch px4_ros_com sensor_combined_listener.launch.py

tasks.label: Session 5: RRT Planner & Offboard Control
args: echo [WAIT] sensor data stream... && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source ~/ws_sensor_combined/install/local_setup.bash && until ros2 topic echo /fmu/out/sensor_combined --qos-reliability best_effort --qos-durability transient_local --once >/dev/null 2>&1; do echo [WAIT] still no data...; sleep 1; done && echo [OK] Data flowing. Starting RRT + Offboard... && source ~/workspace/install/setup.bash && ros2 launch px4_rrt_nav px4_rrt_launch.py
